name: Dalmatian identity
summary: Dalmatian identity is a regional patriotism that treats Dalmatia as its own homeland and culture, a meeting point of Latin-Venetian and Slavic worlds that cuts across Croat, Serb and Italian ethnicity. Politically it has meant autonomy: the 19th-century Autonomist Party kept Dalmatia separate from Croatia-Slavonia within Austria-Hungary, and Dalmatian Action in the 1990s sought a regional government within Croatia. It is a regionalist, anti-ethnic-nationalist current with little recorded economic or social doctrine.
scope: Profile follows the historical Dalmatianist-autonomist line (Tommaseo's idea of a Dalmatian nation, Bajamonti's Autonomist Party, 1860s-1915) and its 1990s revival in Dalmatian Action, as a regional and plural identity. It excludes the Autonomists' later drift to Italian irredentism under the Zara group. Most answers outside regional governance, minorities and ethnicity are low-confidence inferences, because the sources record no economic, moral or foreign-policy program.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Not part of the regionalist program; inferred from a Croatian/Central European setting where public health insurance is the norm and no Dalmatian source opposes it.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Dalmatian identity sources never address wages, and nothing in the regionalist case points either way.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: The Autonomists were a bourgeois, urban party but no source records an economic doctrine, so adherents are not placed either way.

public-ownership.rationale: Inferred from the municipal liberalism of Bajamonti-era Split and a pro-market coastal tourism economy; no source states a view.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: The movement has no recorded fiscal program; its grievances concern Zagreb's political centralism, not class.

unions-good.rationale: Labor organization is not a theme in Dalmatian identity sources; left neutral rather than guessed.

property-fundamental.rationale: The Autonomists' base was the propertied urban bourgeoisie and nobility, so a mild pro-property stance is inferred, not documented.

regulate-corporations.rationale: No documented position; regionalists focus on governance and identity.

cut-welfare.rationale: Inferred from a centrist regionalism with no anti-welfare strand; the modern revived party calls itself ecosocialist.

worker-ownership.rationale: Not part of an urban, liberal-conservative autonomist tradition; inferred only.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Security-liberty tradeoffs do not appear in the sources.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Unaddressed; inferred from a conventional Catholic Mediterranean regional culture.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Inferred from the movement's commitment to coexistence of Croats, Serbs and Italians, but no source discusses speech law.

strong-leader.rationale: Dalmatian Action was defined against Tudjman's centralized, leader-centred state, so a strong-leader answer is inferred as disagree.

state-harmful.rationale: Autonomists sought regional government with a legislative assembly, so they want more institutions, not no state.

empower-police-military.rationale: Inferred from opposition to Tudjman's wartime nationalism and the Krajina conflict context; not stated.

decide-locally.rationale: Tommaseo calls for exercising municipal rights at once, says political guarantees are an illusion without them, and praises communal self-government over the talk of large assemblies.

rehabilitation.rationale: Penal policy is not addressed in Dalmatian identity sources.

traditional-family.rationale: Inferred from a largely Catholic, conservative-leaning regional society; no source states it.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Not addressed; liberal and traditional strands likely split.

abortion-legal.rationale: Not addressed by sources; split between liberal urban and Catholic views.

more-religion-public.rationale: The Dalmatian idea bridged Western Catholic and Eastern Orthodox influences, so adherents are not pushing a religious public role either way.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: The statement concerns race, which is not a theme here.

gender-social-construct.rationale: The sources on Dalmatian autonomism say nothing about gender theory, so adherents are not placed either way.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Dalmatianists prize Dalmatian culture as a Latin-Slavic meeting point; applying it to a national culture is an inference.

gradual-change.rationale: The Autonomist Party defended existing Habsburg autonomy and its constitutional framework, so mild support for gradualism is inferred.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Immigration is not addressed; the sources do mention hostility to displaced inland arrivals in the 1990s but not as program.

free-trade.rationale: A coastal trading and maritime culture suggests openness, but no source states a trade position.

nation-first.rationale: The identity was built against exclusive ethnic nationalism, so putting a nation first is inferred as disliked.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Dalmatian Action spoke of ending the Krajina conflict, not of foreign intervention doctrine; no stated view on rights-based military action.

open-borders.rationale: Not addressed; no source suggests an eventual open-borders aim.

limit-growth.rationale: Tourism-dependent coastal economy suggests growth is welcomed; inference only.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Not addressed (the 2021 revived party's ecosocialism is a different later strand).

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Technology and progress are not themes in the autonomist sources; adherents are neither optimists nor sceptics by doctrine.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Energy policy never entered Dalmatian regionalist programs, so no stance is recorded.

revolution-justified.rationale: Dalmatian Action sought autonomy through legal party politics and denied separatism; revolution is inferred as disfavored.

experts-over-public.rationale: The question of expert versus popular authority is absent from the Autonomist and Dalmatian Action material.

central-planning.rationale: Regionalism opposed to central direction; inferred from anti-centralist stance.

socialized-markets.rationale: Worker or public ownership within markets is not discussed by the regionalist movement.

land-value-tax.rationale: No Dalmatian source mentions land taxation; no position can be inferred.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inheritance tax is absent from the movement's recorded demands.

basic-income.rationale: Unconditional income is a modern idea outside the autonomist tradition's concerns.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Trade-oriented coastal cities make protection less likely; inference only.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Inferred from opposition to Zagreb-directed centralism.

widespread-small-property.rationale: The sources do not discuss distribution of property; a bourgeois and peasant base gives no clear lean.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: No known sympathy; inferred as conventional.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Not addressed; inferred disagree from liberal-regionalist orientation.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: The Autonomists operated loyally within the Habsburg monarchy, though no source argues for monarchy as such.

democracy-best.rationale: The Autonomists competed in Diet elections and resisted nationalists' mass suffrage mostly out of self-interest, so support is inferred and modest.

workers-councils.rationale: No relation to the movement; inferred disagree.

private-courts-defense.rationale: No libertarian strand documented; inferred disagree.

military-superiority.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from anti-nationalist posture.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Not applicable to the Dalmatian context.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Citizenship timing is not discussed; the sources' concern is regional, not immigration law.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Foreign funding of NGOs is not addressed.

residents-only-property.rationale: Not addressed; locals may favor it but the sources do not say.

democratic-peace.rationale: Democratic peace theory is not addressed.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Philosophical anarchism does not appear; the autonomist movement worked within the law, so a mild disagree is inferred.

non-intervention.rationale: Absolute non-intervention is not discussed in the sources, so adherents are not placed.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Contradicts the coexistence ideal; the Autonomists rejected accusations against minorities.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from pro-transparency stance of an opposition party.

local-production.rationale: Localist economics is not discussed in the sources.

informal-organisation.rationale: Dalmatian Action was a formal registered party.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from anti-nationalist outlook.

religious-nation.rationale: The Dalmatian ideal explicitly joined Western Christian (Catholic) and Eastern Orthodox influences.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Tributary diplomacy is entirely foreign to the sources.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Inferred from the autonomist demand for a regional government; no source mentions fiscal terms.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Communist property theory does not appear in the sources.

defeat-communism.rationale: Cold War strategy is not addressed; Dalmatian Action emerged after communism's fall in Yugoslavia, but no stance is recorded.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Public service delivery models are not discussed.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: A Marxist-style historical judgement not addressed in the sources.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Feminist economic theory is not addressed.

socialized-care.rationale: Public provision of housework and childcare is not addressed.

purge-loanwords.rationale: The Dalmatian heritage mixes Venetian-Italian and Slavic words; purism contradicts it.

treaties-binding.rationale: Indigenous treaty law is not relevant to the sources.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Small cooperative communes are a utopian idea outside the sources; adherents lean disagree.

majority-settlement.rationale: Dalmatian regionalists resented the influx of inland Croats in the 1990s and opposed ethnic engineering; inferred.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: A third-way doctrine not found in the sources.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Inferred from the rejection of ethnic territorial claims.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from European norms.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Dalmatian Action was itself targeted by the HDZ government, but no source states the movement's position on suppressing opposition; inferred.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Blasphemy laws conflict with the multi-confessional ideal, though no source addresses them directly.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Colonial economics is not part of the sources; a movement resisting central exploitation would reject it.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: An Islamic legal doctrine without relevance to Dalmatian identity.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: A Salafi-jihadist idea foreign to the sources.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Direct participation is not discussed in the sources.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Transgender legal recognition is not addressed in the sources.

assisted-dying.rationale: End-of-life law is not addressed; Catholic and liberal adherents likely split.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Regionalists often cross the left-right line, but no source says so.

alienated-labor.rationale: The Marxist concept of alienation is not part of the sources.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Religious dress in state institutions is not addressed.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Workplace harassment law is not addressed.

social-market-economy.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from centrist regionalism in a Croatian setting.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Abolition of armies is not part of the sources; adherents lean disagree.

rich-first.rationale: Unbalanced-growth strategy is not discussed in the sources.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Bloc politics are not addressed in the sources.

dynastic-succession.rationale: The Autonomists operated under a hereditary monarchy but did not discuss succession of leaders.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutualist banking is not part of the sources.

property-franchise.rationale: The Diet's census-based franchise favored the Autonomists' bourgeois base until reform in 1870, but no source records them defending it as principle.

reification.rationale: A Marxist-Hegelian concept absent from the sources.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Media ownership critique is not addressed, though Dalmatian Action's journal Glas Dalmacije was a small outlet.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Doctrinal reform is not addressed in the sources.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Wealth concentration is not addressed in the sources.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: LGBT service is not addressed in the sources.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: State atheism has no place in the sources and conflicts with the Catholic and Orthodox traditions of Dalmatia.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Abolitionism has no place in the sources.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: The Autonomists proposed sharing a Dalmatian polity among Croats, Serbs and Italians; inferred support for communal power-sharing.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: The sources say nothing on charity versus state aid.

term-limits.rationale: Term limits are not addressed in the sources.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Church office for women is not addressed in the sources.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Local voting by foreign residents is not addressed.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Drilled youth movements are a nationalist-authoritarian model alien to the sources.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Basing of nuclear weapons is not addressed.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Foreign bases are not addressed in the sources.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Genocide recognition is not addressed, though the 1990s war context is the backdrop of Dalmatian Action.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: The sources say nothing on the basis of income.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Pacifism of this kind is not part of the sources; adherents lean disagree.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: The Dalmatian identity is a layered mix over centuries rather than one unbroken national line.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from anti-nationalist outlook.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Spiritual-warfare politics has no place in a pluralist regionalist movement.

culture-before-state.rationale: Dalmatian identity is more cultural than state-building, but no source states the ordering.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Tommaseo argues against merging Dalmatia into Croatia: Dalmatia was always a separate kingdom with its own government, and inside a common diet its smaller vote would leave it outvoted and ruled by others.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: A socialist definitional dispute not relevant to the sources.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Bajamonti's administration built municipal waterworks and public utilities in Split; inferred support for public local essentials.

second-chamber.rationale: Bicameralism is not discussed; the Diet was unicameral, but no view is recorded.

municipal-property.rationale: Libertarian-municipalist ownership is not addressed in the sources.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Confederal municipalism is not addressed in the sources.

family-wage.rationale: Wage levels for family support are not addressed.

person-over-state.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from regional opposition to a centralizing state.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Anthropology of spirit is not addressed, and Catholic and secular adherents likely split.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Dalmatian Action demanded a regional government and assembly with its own powers; revocable powers would defeat the purpose.

racial-pride.rationale: Race is not a category in Dalmatian identity, so adherents are not placed.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from Dalmatian Action's peace-minded line on Krajina.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Although Dalmatians and Croats share a Slavic speech, the pamphlet holds that history, customs, dress, pronunciation and a mixed Illyrian and Italian heritage make the Dalmatians a distinct people, not Croats.

communal-electorates.rationale: The Autonomists wanted a shared Dalmatian polity, not separate electorates; inferred.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: The sources record accusations of separatism against adherents, not adherent claims of plots.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Gendered values are not addressed in the sources.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Secret treaties are not addressed in the sources.

capital-controls.rationale: Capital controls are not addressed; a trading coast leans against them, by inference only.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Refusal of war orders is not addressed in the sources.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Tax credits for low-paid work are not addressed.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: International economic order is not addressed.

smash-state-machine.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist thesis that contradicts a movement seeking regional institutions within the state.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Economic pluralism between communities is not addressed.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Natural capital accounting is not addressed.

sacred-nation.rationale: A pluralist regional identity does not hold the nation sacred.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Dalmatian regionalists in the 1990s resented Zagreb's treatment of the coast, but sources do not use an exploitation frame.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Perennialism is not addressed, though the Dalmatian ideal bridged Catholic and Orthodox traditions.

farm-price-support.rationale: Agricultural price policy is not addressed.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Nuclear weapons possession has no bearing on a regional movement in Croatia.

workers-own-party.rationale: Inferred from the Autonomists' cross-class, bourgeois urban base and a regional identity that cuts across ethnicity; no source records a class-party view.

ban-fgm.rationale: Not addressed by any source; inferred from a Croatian and Central European setting where the practice is absent and illegal and no Dalmatian source defends custom against law.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; inferred from a European civil-law setting where equal inheritance is the norm and no Dalmatian source argues otherwise.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Inferred from the regionalist insistence on a distinct Dalmatian identity and the 1990 Dalmatian National Party's wish to revive a Dalmatian language; adherents would likely respect regional names, but no source addresses it directly.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Not a theme of the movement; inferred from the municipal-government tradition of Bajamonti-era Split and a modern European setting where agencies set pollution rules.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Inferred from the Autonomists' liberal parliamentary politics in the Diet of Dalmatia and a regional identity with no tradition of chiefs; formal traditional-leader roles are alien to the setting.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: The sources record no environmental doctrine and nothing points either way, though a tourism-dependent coast suggests some sympathy.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the liberal-legalist outlook of the Autonomists and a European judicial tradition that favours judicial discretion.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Adherents are split in principle: the movement defended minority languages and a multi-ethnic region, but accepted the local language as the common medium; no source addresses immigrants.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: The sources record no economic or labour doctrine for Dalmatian identity.

voter-id.rationale: Nothing in the regionalist program concerns voter identification.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Inferred from its plural, multicultural view of Dalmatia (s1) that treats Croat, Serb and Italian communities equally; no source addresses religious interpretations.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: The autonomists used elections and a Diet (s5), but no source says whether elections alone define democracy.

premarital-sex.rationale: Not addressed by any source; a Mediterranean regional identity with no recorded moral doctrine.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Inferred from its anti-centralist, anti-authoritarian regionalism against a nationalist government (s4); nothing states it.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Dalmatian identity has no recorded welfare doctrine.

women-suffrage.rationale: Inferred from its plural and democratic outlook in the modern Dalmatian Action revival; the sources do not discuss it.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: Inferred: a regional-cultural identity that treats Catholic and Orthodox heritage as part of Dalmatian culture would not blame religion; unstated.

race-social-construct.rationale: Inferred from its rejection of ethnic nationalism and its view of identity as cutting across Croat, Serb and Italian lines.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: No source gives a position; adherents' views are unrecorded.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; no position can be inferred.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Inferred from its anti-ethnic-nationalist, plural outlook; the sources do not mention international courts.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Inferred from its Latin-Venetian, secular-liberal 19th-century autonomist lineage; religion as doctrine is not discussed.

gendered-self-government.rationale: Inferred from its plural, inclusive regional identity across ethnic lines; not stated by the sources.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Inferred from its liberal Habsburg-era autonomism and 1990s opposition to Tudjman-style statism; planned economies are not discussed.

indirect-election.rationale: Inferred from its Diet-based, elected regional politics; the sources do not discuss indirect election.

national-church-status.rationale: Inferred from its cross-confessional identity uniting Croats, Serbs and Italians, which a privileged national church would cut against.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Inferred from its regional-autonomy programme; Dalmatians are a regional rather than ethnic group, so the fit is loose.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Inferred from its autonomist view that Dalmatians should decide their own status within Croatia or Austria-Hungary; no plebiscite is recorded.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; no position can be inferred.

simple-living.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; no position can be inferred.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; no position can be inferred.

equal-conscription.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; no position can be inferred.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: The identity treats Dalmatia as a homeland and shared culture, so a tie to the land is inferred, but the sources record no spiritual or duty language.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: Inferred from a regionalist movement that defended municipal rights and legal protections; no source addresses killing suspects.

close-ties-china.rationale: Foreign-policy orientation toward China is not addressed by any source and is anachronistic for the movement.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: The autonomists defended the Italian minority inside Dalmatia; nothing records a policy toward kin abroad.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: The sources record no economic doctrine, so no direction can be inferred.

self-ownership.rationale: The sources record no position on individual self-ownership versus common claims.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Consumption taxes are not addressed by any source.

targeted-social-spending.rationale: Social-spending design is not addressed by any source.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Both the Autonomist Party and Dalmatian Action worked through party and assembly politics, so bypassing parties is inferred to be foreign to them.

no-business-privileges.rationale: The sources record no position on business privileges.

no-denominational-politics.rationale: The identity cut across Croat, Serb and Italian and across Catholic and Orthodox lines, so organising politics by denomination is inferred to cut against it.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: No source addresses technology or ancestral values.

wife-divorce-without-consent.rationale: Inferred from a Central European setting where civil divorce law is standard; no source discusses it.

national-resource-control.rationale: Regional autonomy is the demand; the sources say nothing on national versus foreign control of resources.

distribution-by-process.rationale: The sources record no view on how to judge distributions of wealth.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: Financial taxation is not addressed by any source.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Racial disadvantage is not a theme of the identity; no source addresses it.

unjust-law-not-binding.rationale: The sources record no view on whether unjust laws bind; the autonomists argued through legal and constitutional channels.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Automation is anachronistic and not addressed by any source.

multipolar-world.rationale: Dalmatian regionalism concerns the region within a state and says nothing on a multipolar world order.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: No source records an economic value theory.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: The identity is a regional patriotism, but sources record no link to or conflict with worker-focused politics.

material-over-identity.rationale: The movement was about regional and cultural identity; no source records a view on left priorities.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Inferred from a liberal-regionalist and anti-HDZ position within a multiparty Croatia; no source discusses party-led socialism.

missingStatements.text: A historic region should be kept administratively separate from a neighbouring region it has been historically distinct from.
missingStatements.rationale: The Autonomist Party's defining aim was keeping Dalmatia separate from Croatia-Slavonia.

missingStatements.text: A region's identity can be shared by people of different ethnic and religious backgrounds, and should not be reduced to one nationality.
missingStatements.rationale: The autonomist view defined Dalmatians as a multicultural union of Croats, Serbs and Italians.

missingStatements.text: Regional political parties should be free to campaign for autonomy without being treated as separatist.
missingStatements.rationale: Dalmatian Action denied Tudjman's accusation of separatism and said it sought only autonomy within Croatia.
missingStatements.declined: Autonomy itself is covered by decide-locally and region-keeps-system; the freedom-to-campaign point is a free-speech detail.

notes: Strands differ: the late Autonomists under the Zara leaders (Ziliotto, Bugatto) turned to Italian irredentism, and some Autonomist voices (Borelli) claimed Italian culture was higher; the 1990 Dalmatian National Party wanted to revive the Dalmatian language; the 2021 revived Dalmatian Action calls itself regionalist and ecosocialist.
